final_decision.rationale: Step-level evidence: (1) compression_jpeg: block_boundary 4.05/4.86/7.03 (0%FP), dct_zero 0.889/0.908/0.924; jpeg4 best (jpeg5 +58% bb). (2) blur_glass:5: raw spectral_slope of glass5+jpeg4 matches target within 0.03-0.06 on all 3 pairs while gaussian5 misses by 0.22-0.26; anisotropy 1.24-1.31 rules out motion; wiener corr matches 3/3; gm matches pairs1/2. (3) contrast_weaken_scale:1 (after JPEG): cross-pair target/baseline ratios are consistent (var 0.718/0.745/0.743, chroma 0.901/0.885/0.853, spread 0.838/na/0.829) = linear contrast scale ~0.85; target unique_G 246/218/236 < JPEG-only 255-256 supports a post-JPEG tonal step. No noise: pair1/2 sigma 1.1/0.4, peeled residual structure-dominated, blur+JPEG sims reproduce pair0 sigma 3.95.

reflection_R1.validation_rule: 确定性候选需 >40 dB 或在 k 对上比上一轮 +2 dB. 最佳新候选 (gaussian 链) 在 3/3 对均低于 R0 链 0.26-0.58 dB, 未达阈值 -> NO_CHANGE. R0 链为随机 glass, 3 对均值 25.55 dB; R0 训练 support PSNR 20.15 dB 主要反映温和对比度不可表达 (c~0.85 vs sev1=0.75) 与 blur 随机性, 而非退化族错误.

reflection_R1.residual_uncertainty: 库函数无法精确表示 GT 全局步 (有效 c~0.85, mean +5.4); contrast sev1 方差/unique_G 过冲而均值欠 (+2.0 vs +5.4). glass vs gaussian 冲突由 k=3 PSNR 仲裁 (glass 仅领先 0.45 dB). 若后续训练 PSNR 仍低, 优先怀疑全局步可表达性与 glass 随机性, 而非换族.
